_help: New items (wcmods docs/SDK.md, 'New items'). 'like' borrows what a game item does, its icon and its badge; 'recipe' is what the medicine cat wants for one; 'give' is how many you start with, given once. 'recipes' changes what the game's own herbs and accessories cost (accessories can't be new yet: they need art of their own).
